modes.scope_zh: 仅 MMLU-Pro 固定 200 题；B0/B1 各跑同一组 200 题。
modes.scope_en: MMLU-Pro fixed200 only; the same 200 questions in each of B0 and B1.

modes.scope_zh: 跑完冻结标准的全部五项：MMLU200、HLE 分层 200、Frontier160、SWE trace 32 任务（64 请求/臂）、Terminal trace 32 任务（48 请求/臂）。
modes.scope_en: All five frozen profiles: MMLU200, HLE stratified200, Frontier160, SWE trace32 tasks (64 requests/arm), Terminal trace32 tasks (48 requests/arm).

scope_zh: “全量”指本项目冻结的五项测试范围，不是五个上游数据集的原始全集。快速测试是单数据集检查，不能替代五项验收。SWE/Terminal 仅回放公开 trace 测推理性能，不执行历史工具命令，不报告任务解决率。
scope_en: Full means all five project-frozen profiles, not every item in the five upstream datasets. Quick is a single-dataset check and cannot replace five-profile acceptance. SWE/Terminal replay public traces for inference only; no historical tool commands are executed and no task success rate is reported.

timing.reference_zh: 参考条件：单机双卡 Ascend 910B2、Qwen3.5-35B-A3B BF16、B0 0.18 / B1 冻结 r4，串行配对执行，保持标准生成与评分预算。其他引擎、模型或硬件需重新估时。
timing.reference_en: Reference: one host, two Ascend 910B2 cards, Qwen3.5-35B-A3B BF16, B0 0.18 / frozen B1 r4, serial paired execution with unchanged generation and grading budgets. Re-estimate for other engines, models or hardware.
timing.includes_zh: 主时间范围含本机首次 C8 资格检查、B0/B1 配对、模型加载/图编译、HLE/Frontier 评分（全量）及报告生成。
timing.includes_en: Main ranges include local first-run C8 qualification, both arms, model loading/graph compilation, HLE/Frontier grading (full mode), and report generation.
timing.excludes_zh: 不含首次模型/附件下载、环境安装、资源排队、网络故障或失败后重跑；这些时间另计。
timing.excludes_en: Exclude first-time model/artifact downloads, environment installation, resource queues, network failures and failed-run repeats; budget these separately.
timing.basis_zh: 这是根据 2026-11-12/13 已完成阶段耗时合计后留出余量的排期估算，不是一轮五项一键执行的实测总时长，也不是运行时间保证。
timing.basis_en: Planning ranges sum completed stages from 2026-11-12/13 and add allowance. They are not a measured wall time of one all-five invocation or a runtime guarantee.
timing.qualified_zh: 仅在同机同配置已有有效、封存的 C8 资格证据并通过脚本校验时，才可显式传 --continuous-evidence 复用；新第三方机器应重跑。复用后快速约 1–2 小时，全量约 10–14 小时。
timing.qualified_en: Reuse C8 only with valid sealed evidence for the same host/configuration, explicitly supplied through --continuous-evidence and verified by the runner. New third-party hosts must rerun it. With valid reuse: quick about 1–2 h; full about 10–14 h.

observed_components.basis: Completed selected stages only; failed/unselected stages are not counted. Source campaigns are retained unchanged.

execution.note_zh: 命令适用于 vLLM-HUST Engine 已恢复的执行环境；部署、数据访问和设备参数按其执行清单配置，输出目录须全新。其他引擎沿用同一数据范围，使用各自执行器。不要用 --smoke-evaluators 或 --hle-profile full1811 代替本标准。
execution.note_en: Commands apply to the restored vLLM-HUST Engine environment. Configure deployment, data access and devices using its checklist; use a fresh output directory. Other engines use their own runners with the same dataset scope. Neither --smoke-evaluators nor --hle-profile full1811 represents this standard.
execution.acceptance_zh: 完成所选测试范围不等于所有目标达标；报告仍须逐项判定质量、性能、长稳和成本，并保留失败、截断及未完成项。
execution.acceptance_en: Completing the selected scope does not imply all targets passed. Reports must still judge quality, performance, stability and cost separately and retain failures, truncations and unfinished items.
